title: The Lord Keeps His Word
verse: The Lord visited Sarah just as he had said he would and did for Sarah what he had promised.
observation: The greatest news we can ever hear is that the Lord keeps His promises. The Lord told Abraham and Sarah they would have a child. This was impossible. Abraham was 100 and Sarah was 90. However, nothing is impossible with the Lord. What is even more amazing is they had not been perfect since that promise was given. They tried to make it happen on their own. None of this forfeited God’s ability to do something amazing. We cannot stop God’s promises once they are given. God is faithful.
application: Is there a promise from God’s Word that you need to hold to today?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being faithful.
